paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Avg. JGA score at each turn
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average JGA score for two language models, LLaMA-7B and T5-small, across different turn IDs. The horizontal axis, labeled “Turn ID,” displays a numerical sequence ranging from 1 to 26, representing the progression of each turn. The vertical axis, labeled “Avg. JGA Score,” indicates the average JGA score, with a scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, marked with tick intervals of 0.1. The bar representing LLaMA-7B is depicted in orange and reaches a maximum value of approximately 0.83 at Turn ID 8, with a minimum value of 0.71 at Turn ID 24. The bar representing T5-small is also yellow and attains a maximum value of approximately 0.82 at Turn ID 8, and reaches a minimum value of 0.48 at Turn ID 22. Both bars are sorted in ascending order based on the Turn ID values, and they are not visually emphasized beyond their different colors.
